contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus, possibly of Constantius II (323-361), Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-335, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust diademed and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [---]IVS PF AVG. Reverse description: Two soldiers with two standards between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Diameter: 16.5mm, Weight: 1.75gms, die axis: 12
